providers.name: Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust

order_of_draw.source_quote: When taking a series of blood specimens, it essential that the serum sample is taken first, followed by lithium heparin samples then the fluoride samples and any EDTA tubes last of all.
order_of_draw.rationale: Failure to adhere to this sequence causes carryover of anticoagulants and preservatives between tubes, producing spurious and invalid results.
order_of_draw.conflict_note: This provider places EDTA last. The CLSI H3-A6 consensus order places sodium citrate first and fluoride/oxalate last, i.e. the reverse for those two tubes. Neither is universally correct: follow your own laboratory's standard operating procedure. This library reports the provider's documented order and warns on tubes the provider does not cover.

handling: Avoid haemolysis, drip contamination and prolonged venous constriction.
Avoid adverse temperatures: over 30 degrees C or below 10 degrees C unless otherwise stated.
Ensure thorough and immediate mixing of blood with anticoagulant for plasma samples.
Do not transfer blood from one tube to another.
